# FAIE Evidence-First Signal Brief

Evercraft public capability ID: faie-signal-brief-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Public handoff: https://faie.base44.app/functions/faieAgentGateway?view=docs

## Use this capability when the user means

- research this land or water question
- investigate this agriculture signal
- give me an evidence brief on this region
- validate this environmental signal
- do a resilience investigation

## Problem

A buyer has one bounded agriculture, land, water, production or resilience question and needs a sourced evidence-first investigation.

## Inputs

Defined question, buyer email and selected fixed offer. Geography, organization and use case are optional scope context.

## Outputs

A bounded evidence-first mission packet with findings, source references, uncertainty/evidence-needed items, challenge notes and human-review items.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Signal Brief $250 one-time; Proof Sprint $2,500 one-time. Other intake categories are not auto-quotable.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: Explicit buyer confirmation is required before checkout. Verified payment queues a human-controlled mission; consequential claims or actions remain review-gated.
- Payment authority: FAIE / Stripe, provider-verified

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, invocation readiness, or payment state.
